description: crate-jmap-jscontact-types/PLAN.md:47-48 documents the public API as 'mapped to a String field named at_type'. Every struct in src/lib.rs uses at_type: Option<String> with default + skip_serializing_if. A future contributor cross-referencing PLAN.md will conclude the code is wrong and 'fix' it by removing Option, breaking the deliberate spec-driven flexibility for defaultType-omission cases. PLAN.md is supposed to be the authoritative design record per the workspace AGENTS.md PLAN.md convention. Either update PLAN.md to document the Option<String> choice and its RFC 9553 §1.3.4 motivation, or change the code to match PLAN.md and add explicit handling for the AnniversaryDate.PartialDate-default case.
title: PLAN.md says at_type: String but code uses at_type: Option<String>
